name: Ever Our Hearts Aglow...
source:
IN THE BEGINNING there was Light or so God supposedly said but in truth we are only in darkness... Camry the Cat is in darkness as well, one that threatens to Engulf him from all directions... Until a certain hero comes into his life to save him but perhaps this hero is actually a villain after all, for, who can say what is truly a hero or villain in this world of only shades of gray (but dark gray)...

[From [url=https://galsult.itch.io/ever-our-hearts-aglow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
据说一开始就有光，但事实上我们只是在黑暗中……猫卡莫里也处于黑暗中，黑暗威胁着从四面八方吞没他……直到某个英雄进入他的生活来拯救他，但也许这个英雄实际上是一个恶棍，因为，在这个只有灰色阴影（但深灰色）的世界里，谁能说什么是真正的英雄或恶棍……

[来自[url=https://galsult.itch.io/ever-our-hearts-aglow]Itch.io[/url]]
